blurb: Big Ed's Guide Service offers guided bass fishing trips on Lake of the Ozarks and the Osage River. The guide practices catch, photograph, and release to preserve fish populations. Trips are available from spring through fall and winter, with a focus on bass fishing and some crappie fishing in early spring.
